```yaml
name: Deploy OfficeIMO Website

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'Website/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'Website/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout OfficeIMO
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout PSWriteOffice
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: EvotecIT/PSWriteOffice
          path: C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice
          # Use READ_ALL if available, otherwise default token permissions
          token: ${{ secrets.READ_ALL_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v5
        with:
          pwsh-version: '7.4.x'

      - name: Install PowerShell Modules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name PlatyPS -Force -Scope CurrentUser -AllowClobber
          Install-Module -Name MarkdownPS -Force -Scope CurrentUser -AllowClobber
          Install-Module -Name Plaster -Force -Scope CurrentUser -AllowClobber
          Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser -AllowClobber

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Build Website
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          cd Website
          ./build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot "C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice"

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: './Website/_site'

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

      - name: Configure Cloudflare (Optional)
        if: env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != ''
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          command: pages deploy Website/_site --project-name=officeimo
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO }}
```
